prompt:
# Ronenguard Bill: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10062/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Ronenguard Bill in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the compact pale hooked teardrop head, one long up-curved point, dark inset, plain orange-brown shaft, and only its simple dark and gold bands. Render one full-length bill on transparent RGBA without invented studs or decoration..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Ronenguard Bill in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the compact pale hooked teardrop head, one long up-curved point, dark inset, plain orange-brown shaft, and only its simple dark and gold bands. Render one full-length bill on transparent RGBA without invented studs or decoration.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10062/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input roles: first image paint_mask_guide.png is the exact edit target. Second design_reference.png is appearance reference only. Third icon_x8.png is colour reference only. Preserve the guide's full 3:4 canvas and small silhouettes at their existing positions. Output the complete sheet, not a single enlarged weapon. Lower-half metal head and both bands are red, wooden shaft yellow. All background is transparent.
CORRECTION: strictly preserve all silhouette gaps from the grey guide, especially the long transparent rectangular openings near the heads in horizontal side views. Absolutely no paint splatter or stray pixels around any silhouette. Lower mask silhouettes must have perfectly clean boundaries and solid flat red/yellow interiors. Do not fill the transparent slots. Copy geometry exactly from input 1. Maintain thin shafts exactly matching guide. Canvas 1536x2048.

validation.visual_notes: Layout retained; visible edge spill remains after permitted correction. Raw output preserved without editing.
